title: Ethiopian Cabbage Alicha
localName: ጥቅል ጎመን አልጫ — Tikil Gomen Alicha
community: All of Ethiopia — the pure cabbage alicha
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Cabbage Alicha — plain cabbage cooked with onion, oil, and a pinch of turmeric in the mildest possible Ethiopian vegetable preparation. The truly mild element of the fasting platter — for children, those new to Ethiopian food, and to provide balance.
longDesc: Cabbage Alicha is the simplest Ethiopian vegetable dish — just cabbage, onion, oil, and a touch of turmeric. Its role on the platter is balance: where everything else has berbere or complexity, this provides pure, gentle simplicity.
ingredients: ½ head white cabbage — roughly chopped
steps: Heat oil. Cook onion until golden.
Add garlic and turmeric. Stir 30 seconds.
chefTips: The simplest possible preparation — do not add more.
sustainabilityTips: Cabbage — the most affordable vegetable year-round.
servedWith: For children on the non-fasting table
culturalNote: Cabbage alicha is the inclusivity dish of the Ethiopian table — mild enough for the youngest child and the most heat-sensitive guest. Its simplicity is a virtue.
